dialogue_texts: Why have you returned, My Majesty? Also, who's this?
Hiroyuki Shirogane, head of the Shirogane Manor.
So some cool man just shows up and he's part of your group?
Fufufu, the Empress requires a proper entourage when exploring such an endless, delightful night.
Besides, Shirogane-sama here possesses quite a fascinating understanding of this labyrinth.
Don't treat this as a casual stroll, My Majesty.
The spiritual matrix of this entire courtyard is twisting. It's a deliberate spatial inversion.
Exactly! This courtyard is under strict orders to stay locked down.
I don't care if you're royalty from the moon or whatever - nobody gets past my broom without a thorough sweeping!
